subject_description: a hulking berserker knight in black spiked plate armor with a horned helm, a torn red cape and a gigantic jagged black greatsword
initial_pose: standing with his back to the camera, the gigantic greatsword resting on his shoulder
description: a heavy, powerful running cycle in place running away from the camera: big strides, legs driving, the heavy armored body bobbing up and down, the free arm pumping, the gigantic greatsword stays resting on his shoulder the whole time, the torn red cape flapping behind him; a seamless loop, he stays in the middle of the picture. Back to the camera in every frame. No effects, no dust, no smoke, no motion trails.
